class.name: Simulation
class.brief_description: Runs the stocksim market simulation and streams its events to scripts.
class.description: Wraps the C++ simulation core: an order book with price-time priority, market/limit/stop/stop-limit orders, an event log, and time travel ([method step_back]). All market logic lives in the core; this node only translates. Drive it manually with [method step_event] and [method step_tick], or continuously with [method run], which advances the simulation on a worker thread. Either way, read what happened by calling [method drain_events] every frame: each event is one row of [constant EVENT_STRIDE] integers in a [PackedInt64Array], indexed with the [code]EVENT_FIELD_*[/code] constants. [codeblock] var rows: PackedInt64Array = simulation.drain_events() for base: int in range(0, rows.size(), Simulation.EVENT_STRIDE): var reason: int = rows[base + Simulation.EVENT_FIELD_REASON] print(Simulation.reason_text(reason)) [/codeblock] Prices are integer ticks and quantities are integer lots; there is no floating point in market data. Events are never dropped: when the event buffer is full, the worker waits until it is drained, and manual stepping reports an error. All methods must be called from the main thread. Queries return the state at the moment of the call; while running, that state may be ahead of the events drained so far.

method.name: can_step_back
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there is a step to undo with [method step_back].

method.name: cancel_order
method.description: Queues a cancel of order [param order_id] on behalf of [param account]. The outcome arrives as an [constant EVENT_ORDER_CANCELLED] or [constant EVENT_COMMAND_REJECTED] event (for example [constant REASON_NOT_ORDER_OWNER]).

method.name: configure
method.description: Replaces the simulation with a new one configured by [param scenario], a parsed scenario object (see [code]docs/scenario-format.md[/code]). Unknown keys, wrong types and out-of-range values are rejected. Stops any [method run] and discards undrained events. Returns [constant OK] or an error code, logging the reason.

method.name: drain_events
method.description: Removes and returns up to [param max_events] of the oldest undelivered events (all of them if negative), as consecutive rows of [constant EVENT_STRIDE] integers. Call it every frame; draining also lets a paused worker continue.

method.name: event_type_name
method.description: Returns the name of an event type, such as [code]"Match"[/code] for [constant EVENT_MATCH].

method.name: get_account
method.description: Returns account [param account] as [constant ACCOUNT_STRIDE] integers indexed with the [code]ACCOUNT_FIELD_*[/code] constants, or an empty array if it has never been opened or traded. Cash is in price ticks x shares; positions are in shares.

method.name: get_best_ask
method.description: Returns the lowest resting sell price in ticks, or [code]0[/code] when there are no sell orders (check [method has_best_ask]).

method.name: get_best_bid
method.description: Returns the highest resting buy price in ticks, or [code]0[/code] when there are no buy orders (check [method has_best_bid]).

method.name: get_current_tick
method.description: Returns the current simulation tick.

method.name: get_depth
method.description: Returns up to [param max_levels] (at most 4096) price levels on [param side], best price first, as rows of [constant DEPTH_STRIDE] integers indexed with the [code]DEPTH_FIELD_*[/code] constants.

method.name: get_event_schema_version
method.description: Returns the version of the event layout. It changes whenever event fields, types or reasons change meaning.

method.name: get_last_price
method.description: Returns the price of the most recent trade in ticks, or [code]0[/code] before the first trade (check [method has_last_price]). This is the market price: the last trade, not a measure of value.

method.name: get_last_sequence
method.description: Returns the sequence number of the most recent event in the current state ([code]0[/code] before any event). After [signal rewound], discard any held event with a larger sequence number.

method.name: get_order
method.description: Returns the live order [param order_id] as [constant ORDER_STRIDE] integers indexed with the [code]ORDER_FIELD_*[/code] constants, or an empty array if it is not live (filled, cancelled, rejected, or not yet processed).

method.name: get_pending_event_count
method.description: Returns the number of events waiting to be returned by [method drain_events].

method.name: get_scenario_name
method.description: Returns the [code]name[/code] of the loaded scenario, or [code]"Default"[/code].

method.name: get_steps_per_second
method.description: Returns the speed passed to the latest [method run] call ([code]0[/code] means unthrottled).

method.name: get_tick_volume
method.description: Returns the quantity traded so far in the current tick.

method.name: get_total_volume
method.description: Returns the total quantity traded since the simulation started.

method.name: get_trade_count
method.description: Returns the number of trades since the simulation started.

method.name: has_best_ask
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any sell order is resting on the book.

method.name: has_best_bid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any buy order is resting on the book.

method.name: has_last_price
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once at least one trade has happened.

method.name: has_redo
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after [method step_back] while there is recorded future that [method step_event] and [method step_tick] will replay. Any new order, cancel or modify discards it.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while [method run] is advancing the simulation.

method.name: load_scenario
method.description: Reads a scenario JSON file at [param path] and applies it with [method configure]. Returns [constant OK] or an error code, logging the reason (including the line of a JSON syntax error).

method.name: load_state
method.description: Replaces the simulation with one restored from [param data], as produced by [method save_state]. History is not restored, so [method can_step_back] is [code]false[/code] afterwards. Returns [constant OK], or [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] / [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] for data from another version or corrupt data.

method.name: modify_order
method.description: Queues a change of resting order [param order_id] to [param new_limit_price] and [param new_qty]. Reducing quantity at the same price keeps the order's place in the queue; any price change or quantity increase moves it to the back, and it may trade immediately.

method.name: pause
method.description: Stops a [method run]. The simulation keeps its state and can be stepped manually or run again.

method.name: reason_text
method.description: Returns the fixed English explanation of a [code]REASON_*[/code] code, for narration.

method.name: run
method.description: Starts advancing the simulation on a worker thread at [param steps_per_second] (a step is one event-producing step or one tick advance); [code]0[/code] runs as fast as possible. Calling it again changes the speed. Results do not depend on the speed or on timing: only on the inputs and their order.

method.name: save_state
method.description: Returns the complete current market state as bytes, for [method load_state].

method.name: step_back
method.description: Undoes the most recent step (and any orders, cancels or modifies given after it), then emits [signal rewound]. Returns [code]false[/code] at the beginning. Undelivered events from the undone future are discarded.

method.name: step_event
method.description: Performs (or replays, after [method step_back]) one step, which emits at most four events. Returns [code]false[/code] if there was nothing to do. Fails with an error if the event buffer is full; call [method drain_events] first.

method.name: step_tick
method.description: Performs steps until the tick advances. Returns [code]true[/code] when the tick advanced, or [code]false[/code] if it stopped early because the event buffer filled up; drain and call again to continue.

method.name: submit_order
method.description: Queues a new order and returns its id. [param limit_price] is used by limit and stop-limit orders, [param stop_price] by stop and stop-limit orders; both are in ticks. The order is validated when processed: watch for [constant EVENT_ORDER_PLACED] or [constant EVENT_ORDER_REJECTED] with this id. Returns [code]0[/code] and logs an error if an argument is out of range.

signal.name: rewound
signal.description: Emitted by [method step_back]. Events with a sequence number greater than [param last_sequence] no longer happened; remove them from anything that displays them.
